milestone.title: raul sort cycle consistency across Milestones / Backlog / Ideas

intent.outcome: All three list-style lanes in raul (Milestones, Backlog, Ideas) use the same 6-stop sort cycle grammar, same column-header sort behavior, and same `o` cycle key. Sort choices persist via the [ui].sort framework introduced by M204. Per-tab stop order: Milestones uses Id, Title, Priority, Stage, Created, Updated; Backlog uses Id, Title, Priority, Status, Created, Resolved-at; Ideas uses Id, Title, Priority, Status, Created, Tags. After this lands, operators learn one sort UX and apply it across all three lanes.

problem.description: Today the three list-style lanes have different sort cycles. Milestones has 5 stops (Id, Title, Priority, Lifecycle, Updated); Backlog and Ideas have 4 stops each (Id, Title, Priority, Status) and no Created sort key even though M203 adds `created` to BacklogItem. The Milestones Lifecycle sort duplicates the information the new Stage column (M202) already shows. Ideas have a `tags` field that is never sortable. Backlog has `resolved_at` for resolved items but no sort key uses it. After M204 introduces sort persistence, the underlying `sort_keys_for(Lane)` function still reflects the pre-M202/pre-M203/pre-M204 design — the sort UX is the last unaligned piece across the three lanes.

in_scope: Update `SortKey` enum in `crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs`: rename `Lifecycle` to `Stage`; add `Created`, `ResolvedAt`, `Tags` variants. Update `label()` and any rank helpers. Persistence stays on the M182 `sort.<lane>` keys (M204 only added debounce on cycle `o`); the variant names are the only change.

Update `sort_keys_for(Lane)` in `crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs` to the new per-lane cycles: Milestones = [Id, Title, Priority, Stage, Created, Updated]; Backlog = [Id, Title, Priority, Status, Created, ResolvedAt]; Ideas = [Id, Title, Priority, Status, Created, Tags]. Six stops each.

Update sort comparator implementations in `visible_milestones()` and `visible_backlog()` to handle the new keys: `Stage` uses `flow_stages` (current mp-flow stage, after M202); `Created` uses the real `created` field on MilestoneMeta / BacklogItem / IdeaEntry (NOT lifecycle_at — that is `Updated`); `ResolvedAt` uses `resolved_at`; `Tags` uses first tag alphabetically with subsequent tags as tiebreak.

Update column-header sort behavior in `render_milestones_table` and `render_backlog_list` to support the new keys. The `▼` indicator and click-to-sort semantics stay the same; only the column-to-key mapping updates.
Extend `MilestoneSummary` (after M202) and `BacklogLine` (after M203) to carry any new fields required for sorting (`flow_stages`, `created`). No new persistence fields.
Persist `sort` choice via the existing `sort.<lane>` keys (M182 + M204 debounce). New variants serialize as their `label()` string (`stage`, `created`, `resolved-at`, `tags`).

Tests: unit (each new sort comparator — Stage, Created, ResolvedAt, Tags — on fixture data; Created vs Updated on Milestones are different); TUI snapshot (cycle `o` walks all six stops on each lane; column header shows `▼` on active key; sort persistence round-trips through `sort.<lane>`); legacy compat (pre-M205 `sort.milestones = "lifecycle"` falls back to default — forward-compat pattern).
out_of_scope: Filter modal changes — owned by M204.
Bulk operations — not this milestone and not M206 (M206 is Path tab rework).
The Stage column itself — owned by M202.
Adding `created` to BacklogItem — owned by M203. MilestoneMeta.created already exists.
Custom sort expressions or user-defined sort orders — overkill for v1.
Sort by stage within a single milestone (e.g. `SortKey::Stage` for Backlog items) — Stage sort is Milestones-only.
Sort by `body` length or other derived fields — out of scope.
Renaming `Lifecycle` outside the `SortKey` enum — the `milestone.lifecycle` field on MilestoneMeta stays; only the sort key is renamed.
Using `lifecycle_at` as a Created proxy — that would make Created and Updated the same sort on Milestones.

acceptance_criteria.description: All three list-style lanes (Milestones, Backlog, Ideas) have a 6-stop sort cycle. Per-lane order: Milestones = [Id, Title, Priority, Stage, Created, Updated]; Backlog = [Id, Title, Priority, Status, Created, ResolvedAt]; Ideas = [Id, Title, Priority, Status, Created, Tags]. `sort_keys_for(Lane)` is the single source of truth.

Stage sort on Milestones uses `flow_stages` (current mp-flow stage, computed as the first non-done, non-skipped stage in MP_FLOW_STAGE_KEYS canonical order — same logic as the Stage column cell). Tiebreak on Id.

Created sort uses the created field on all three lanes (MilestoneMeta.created, BacklogItem.created, IdeaEntry.created). Updated on Milestones continues to use lifecycle_at (last transition). Created and Updated are different keys. Tiebreak on Id.

ResolvedAt sort on Backlog uses `resolved_at` (RFC3339 date string). Unresolved items sort to the bottom under ascending order (or to the top under descending — implementation choice pinned in test). Tiebreak on Id.
Tags sort on Ideas uses the first tag alphabetically as the primary key, subsequent tags as stable tiebreak. Ideas with no tags sort to the bottom under ascending order. Tiebreak on Id.

Cycle `o` walks all six stops on each lane in the documented order. From any starting position, one `o` press advances to the next stop; wrap-around from the last stop to the first. The footer indicator shows the active sort key as `sort: <key> ▼`.

Column-header sort behavior is consistent across lanes. Clicking a column header sorts by that key (toggle ascending/descending); active key shows `▼`. Header cells for keys not in the lane's cycle render as plain labels (no `▼`).

Sort persistence via existing sort.<lane> still works. Changing the cycle writes sort.<lane> within 1s via the M204 debounce. Restarting restores. Pre-M205 value lifecycle falls back to the per-lane default.

`cargo fmt --all -- --check` exits 0; `cargo clippy -p mp --tests --no-deps -- -D warnings` exits 0; `cargo clippy -p raul --tests --no-deps -- -D warnings` exits 0; `cargo nextest run -p mp --no-fail-fast` exits 0; `cargo nextest run -p raul --no-fail-fast` exits 0; `mp validate` exits 0.

design_decisions.rationale: Six is enough to express the per-lane dimensions without crowding. Three shared stops (Id, Title, Priority) plus three lane-specific (Stage/Updated for Milestones; Status/ResolvedAt for Backlog; Status/Tags for Ideas).

design_decisions.choice: Replace Lifecycle with Stage in the Milestones sort cycle
design_decisions.rationale: Stage (from M202 flow_stages) is the operator-facing view; Lifecycle is bookkeeping the operator sees in the Status column. Sorting by Stage aligns the sort with what the Stage column shows. Lifecycle is still the source of truth in MilestoneMeta; the sort key just changes name.

design_decisions.choice: Use MilestoneMeta.created (YYYY-MM-DD). lifecycle_at stays the Updated key (already SortKey::Updated).
design_decisions.rationale: The original choice used lifecycle_at as a Created proxy, which would make Created and Updated the same sort on Milestones. The created field already exists on MilestoneMeta. Age-since-created (M204) and Created sort then share one field.

design_decisions.choice: Include ResolvedAt as the sixth stop
design_decisions.rationale: Useful for audit / cleanup views — operators can find recently resolved items. The unresolved-items-to-bottom behavior keeps the active work visible at the top under ascending order.

design_decisions.choice: First tag alphabetically + subsequent tags as tiebreak
design_decisions.rationale: Gives a stable, predictable order. Operators who tag ideas with stable prefixes (`spec-grill`, `mp-flow`, etc.) get useful groupings. Empty-tags sort to the bottom under ascending.

design_decisions.choice: Reuse M204 persistence framework; serialize variants as label() strings
design_decisions.rationale: No new persistence plumbing. The SortKey label() method (already extended for the new variants) provides the on-disk string. M204's debounced save handles the writes.

design_decisions.choice: lifecycle in pre-M205 [ui].sort.<lane> falls back to default gracefully
design_decisions.rationale: Operators who already have a persisted `lifecycle` value from before M205 don't see a broken UI. Forward-compat: any unrecognized sort string falls back to the per-lane default (id).

design_decisions.choice: Both use the same flow_stages map; same computation
design_decisions.rationale: Single source of truth. The Stage cell and the Stage sort key share the `progress::stage_cell_line` / equivalent logic. Operators see consistent ordering whether scanning the list or sorting by it.

open_questions.question: For the ResolvedAt sort on Backlog, do unresolved items sort to the bottom under ASCENDING order or DESCENDING order? (Pick one and pin in test.)
open_questions.answer: Unresolved items sort to the bottom in both ASC and DESC directions. Active work stays at the top regardless of sort direction. Pinned in test: unresolved_items_always_at_bottom.

open_questions.question: For the Tags sort on Ideas, do items with empty tags sort to the bottom under ascending order, or are they interleaved with the alphabetical run?
open_questions.answer: No-tag items sort to the bottom in both ASC and DESC directions. Operators see real Ideas first; untagged ones (often still raw) at the end. Matches M203 resolved-collapse pattern.

open_questions.question: When persisting a SortKey variant, do we use the label() string (kebab-case) or a serde rename to a shorter form? The M204 framework persists whatever serde produces.
open_questions.answer: Serialize SortKey as its label() string verbatim (stage, created, resolved-at, tags). Self-describing; matches M204 pattern. No custom serde rename. label() returns the kebab-case form.

work_packages.name: SortKey enum + sort cycle unification
work_packages.goal: Update SortKey enum: rename Lifecycle to Stage; add Created, ResolvedAt, Tags variants. Update label() and rank helpers. Update sort_keys_for(Lane) to the new per-lane 6-stop cycles (Milestones: Id Title Priority Stage Created Updated; Backlog: Id Title Priority Status Created ResolvedAt; Ideas: Id Title Priority Status Created Tags). Covers AC-01 plus the SortKey foundation for AC-02 through AC-08.
work_packages.rollback: Revert SortKey variants. Revert sort_keys_for. Sort cycles revert to pre-M205 state.

work_packages.name: Sort comparator implementations
work_packages.goal: Implement the four new comparators: Stage (flow_stages), Created (created field on all lanes — not lifecycle_at), ResolvedAt (resolved_at, unresolved to bottom), Tags (first tag alphabetically). Wire into visible_milestones() and visible_backlog(). Covers AC-02, AC-03, AC-04, AC-05.
work_packages.rollback: Revert the new comparator match arms. SortKeys fall back to id ordering when accessed (the unreachable arm is documented in tests). Other WP functionality remains.

work_packages.name: Column header sort + persistence + final verification
work_packages.goal: Update column-header sort behavior in render_milestones_table and render_backlog_list: each column header maps to its SortKey; click to toggle ascending/descending; active key shows v; non-lane keys render plain label. Wire the legacy lifecycle fallback in [ui].sort.<lane] (forward-compat: unrecognized value falls back to per-lane default silently per M204 Q-01 resolution). Run full verification matrix. Covers AC-06, AC-07, AC-08, AC-09.
work_packages.rollback: Revert column header sort behavior. Revert legacy compat fallback. Other WP functionality remains.

steps.action: Implement the Stage sort for Milestones: uses flow_stages (current mp-flow stage). The same computation as the M202 Stage column cell: first non-done, non-skipped stage in MP_FLOW_STAGE_KEYS canonical order. Fallback to lifecycle text when flow_stages is empty. Tiebreak on Id. Test sort_by_stage_uses_flow_stages and sort_by_stage_tiebreak_is_id pass.
steps.done_when: Both named tests pass; Stage sort orders milestones by current mp-flow stage

steps.action: Drop the SortKey::Lifecycle variant entirely; the M202 Stage column already owns that signal. Update every caller that referenced SortKey::Lifecycle to SortKey::Stage. Verify with cargo grep that no remaining code paths use Lifecycle.
steps.done_when: No references to SortKey::Lifecycle remain; named test passes

steps.action: Implement Created sort: all three lanes use the created field (MilestoneMeta.created, BacklogItem.created, IdeaEntry.created). Do not use lifecycle_at here — that remains Updated. Parse YYYY-MM-DD / RFC3339; tiebreak on Id. Add a test that Created and Updated produce different orders when created != lifecycle_at.
steps.done_when: All 3 named tests pass; Created sort orders correctly per lane

steps.action: Update SortKey enum in crates/raul/src/tui/app.rs: rename Lifecycle variant to Stage; add Created, ResolvedAt, Tags variants. Update label() to return stage, created, resolved-at, tags respectively. Update sort_keys_for(Lane) to the new 6-stop per-lane cycles: Milestones = [Id, Title, Priority, Stage, Created, Updated]; Backlog = [Id, Title, Priority, Status, Created, ResolvedAt]; Ideas = [Id, Title, Priority, Status, Created, Tags]. Tests for sort_keys_for_per_lane_have_six_stops and per_lane_order_matches_spec.
steps.done_when: All 4 named tests pass; SortKey has 9 variants; sort_keys_for returns the right 6-stop list per lane

steps.action: Implement the ResolvedAt sort for Backlog: uses BacklogItem.resolved_at (RFC3339 date). Unresolved items sort to the bottom under both ASC and DESC directions per Q-01 resolution (unresolved_items_always_at_bottom). Tiebreak on Id. Test sort_by_resolved_at_uses_resolved_at_field, sort_by_resolved_at_unresolved_items_go_to_bottom, sort_by_resolved_at_tiebreak_is_id all pass.
steps.done_when: All 3 named tests pass; ResolvedAt sort works correctly with unresolved-to-bottom under both directions

steps.action: Wire legacy sort.milestones=lifecycle forward-compat fallback: when the persisted value does not match any current SortKey label, fall back to the per-lane default silently (already the M182 loader behavior). Test: write lifecycle to sort.milestones, simulate relaunch, assert loaded key is Id not Lifecycle.
steps.done_when: Named test passes; unknown persisted values fall back to default silently

steps.action: Update column-header sort behavior in render_milestones_table and render_backlog_list: each header maps to its SortKey; click toggles ascending/descending; active key shows v. Headers for keys not in the lane cycle render as plain labels (no v). Update the existing column_to_key map in both renderers. Tests for column_header_click_sorts_by_key, active_key_shows_arrow, non_lane_keys_render_plain_label.
steps.done_when: All 3 named tests pass; column headers sort + show v correctly

steps.action: Implement the Tags sort for Ideas: uses the IdeaEntry.tags array. Primary sort: first tag alphabetically. Tiebreak: subsequent tags alphabetically (stable). Items with no tags sort to the bottom under both ASC and DESC per Q-02 resolution (no_tag_items_at_bottom). Tiebreak on Id. Test sort_by_tags_uses_first_tag_alphabetically, sort_by_tags_uses_subsequent_tags_as_tiebreak, sort_by_tags_no_tag_items_go_to_bottom, sort_by_tags_tiebreak_is_id all pass.
steps.done_when: All 4 named tests pass; Tags sort works correctly with no-tag items to bottom
